answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the karst is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the tide of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
